outcome: term pregnancy premature rupture of membranes (PROM)
cohort: The study included 200 pregnant women with ultrasound results of fibroid.
finding: Uterine fibroid pregnancies are often asymptomatic but are associated with early pregnancy abortion, term pregnancy PROM, postpartum PPH, malpresentation, and significantly high cesarean section rates, categorizing them as high-risk pregnancies.
mod_finding: The most prevalent delivery method among pregnant women with uterine fibroids was cesarean section (62%), followed by vaginal delivery (25%), which included instrumental and aided breech births.
